static_traits.name: Lin Lan
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；过去not yet接受过心理治疗；既往在与工作相关的情境中出现相似的Anxiety与灾难化思维。
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高，能识do not并描述自身的思维模式；语气平稳但主诉Anxiety明显；倾向对他人话语进行过度分析。

basic_info.main_problem: 我经常把情况灾难化，导致Anxiety和压力。例如，今天下午老板给我安排了一个会议，我的第一反应是他认为我表现not好，想让我进入试用期。这些Anxiety性和灾难化的想法从我记事起就存在，最近几个月更加明显。我倾向于期待最坏结果、过度分析并草率下结论，尤其在工作中、会前或收到反馈时频繁出现。
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent anxiety与压力已开始影响我的工作表现和整体幸福感，因此我希望通过咨询来改善。
growth_experiences: 长期以来（从记事起）在工作相关情境中频繁出现灾难化与Anxiety的思维模式；过去常在类似情境下通过“更努力工作以证明自己”来应对；not yet曾接受过心理治疗，且without显著躯体疾病。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough／我可能是个失败者

special_situations.event: The boss scheduling an afternoon meeting on the same day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果老板突然安排会议，通常意味着我表现not佳，可能被处分或进入试用期
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍工作以证明自己，并在会前Over-preparation与担忧
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他认为我做得not好，可能要让我进入试用期

special_situations.event: Receiving performance or daily feedback at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人给我反馈，往往意味着他们对我not满或negate我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-analyzes others' words and expressions, looking for negative signs

special_situations.event: A meeting is approaching; needing to discuss work matters in front of colleagues
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my work is discussed in front of colleagues, I will make a fool of myself and be seen as a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Worrying in advance, rehearsing the worst case to try to avoid losing control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会在大家面前丢脸，所有人都会认为I am a failure

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, fairly evaluated, and to have stable job security
core_conflict.fear: Fears being criticized or humiliated and defined as a failure, thereby affecting work and interpersonal relations
defense_goal: 通过过度努力和预先预判最坏情形来减少not确定性与风险
Maintains high sensitivity to others' evaluations to avoid 'mistakes'

object_relations.self_representation: 容易被negate、可能失败的员工
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges or superiors who may impose sanctions
旁观并评判自己的同事

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others (such as a supervisor or the counselor) discuss her work performance, arrange a meeting, or offer feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对方视为严苛的评判者，潜意识认为对方对自己not满并可能羞辱自己
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以支持性语气温和指出其为推测，邀请举证与具体化情境；use开放式问题，减少对抗，帮助其区分事实与假设。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈到可能出现的负面后果或not确定情境时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 用抽象推论与过度分析来控制not确定性，回避直接感受Anxiety与脆弱
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 引导其关注当下体验与身体感受，放慢语速，用具体事实替代抽象推论；以Empathy语气承接Anxiety后再进行现实检验。

positive_force: Received positive evaluation from the boss last quarter; colleagues often seek their help, positive feedback from others exists
具备深呼吸与正念等自我调节策略，能在短时内缓解Anxiety
愿意Actively seeks counseling, positive attitude并愿意练习重构思维
Higher education level; has professional ability and a work foundation
negative_force: 灾难化、跳到结论（读心术与预测not yet来）、过度概括与个人化的认知倾向
对最坏结果的持续担忧导致Sleep disturbance
Over-analyzes others' words and feedback, highly sensitive to evaluation
长期的工作相关Anxiety影响工作表现与同事关系

target_behavior.behavior: 在工作情境中出现灾难化思维并伴随强烈Anxiety
target_behavior.core_reason: 对负面评价的高度敏感与灾难化认知模式（读心术、预测not yet来、过度概括与个人化）
target_behavior.function: Escapes potential failure and humiliation to seek safety and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected、Interpersonal relationships受损、睡眠被持续担忧打断，整体Decline in sense of well-being
